title: SLO gap detector and staged quiet restoration for circuit reopen stability
author: Marcus Chen
description:
Motivation: During a recent regional partial outage we observed rapid circuit reopen/close oscillations causing cascading SLO breaches after a short recovery window. Root cause: the current reopen policy treats instantaneous health probes and token-latency spikes equally which allows transient noise to drive full reopen attempts. This PR introduces a lightweight SLO gap detector that compares short-term observed SLO metrics (p99 latency and error-rate) against the expected baseline and gates reopen attempts when a gap is present. In addition we add a staged quiet restoration mechanism: when a circuit transitions from OPEN->HALF_OPEN we now apply a controlled, timeboxed traffic ramp and a quieting window where aggressive reopen is suppressed and telemetry is sampled at a higher rate for confident decisioning. This reduces reopen flip-flops and prevents premature failovers.

What changed (summary): Added a new slo_gap_detector module in the runtime health package that calculates gap_score = weighted_delta(expected_slo, observed_window) and emits a decision token. Circuit manager now queries the slo_gap_detector before allowing HALT->HALF_OPEN full reopen; if gap_score exceeds threshold we extend the silent recovery window and apply staged traffic percentages (10%, 30%, 70%) with exponential backoff between steps. Introduced telemetry flags to increase sampling fidelity during staged restore and a short-lived feature flag to allow rollback. Small changes to config schema to add per-region slo_baseline references and staged_restore policy parameters.

Why this approach: Conservative reopen prevents oscillations without sacrificing long-term availability. The gap detector is intentionally stateless (windowed metrics) to avoid complex reconciliation, and the staged restore progression mirrors the successful canary rollout model used elsewhere in the platform. The change is opt-in per region by default to avoid impacting customers with custom failover policies.

Checklist:
- [x] slo gap detector implementation and unit tests
- [x] circuit manager integration and e2e harness update
- [x] staged restore policy config and migration logic
- [x] increased telemetry sampling toggle and docs snippet
- [x] feature flag and rollback path
- [x] manual canary in us-west-2 performed with internal load generator

Testing and validation: Unit tests cover gap_score math with synthetic baselines and noisy inputs, integration tests exercise transition sequences including extended silent windows and staged traffic ramps. A dedicated e2e run simulated a region recovery pattern with injected latency spikes; the new logic held the circuit in HALF_OPEN with slow ramping and avoided a second full-open event while overall p99 improved for neighbor regions. CI: lint, unit, integration, and staging deploy jobs passed. We also observed no significant CPU/GPU overhead in the runtime heap profiles during staging.

Rollout plan: Feature-flagged rollout starting with a controlled canary in us-west-2 for one week (monitor SLO delta and incident rate), then us-east-1, then global by region over two weeks. If SLO delta increases >1.5x or customer-facing error rates exceed threshold, the feature-flag will be toggled off automatically by the rollout monitor.

Revert plan: The feature flag can be toggled off instantly. For safety, rolling back will also trigger an automated soft-reopen of any circuits held in silent windows to avoid stuck HALF_OPEN states.

Files changed (high level): runtime/health/slo_gap_detector.go (new), runtime/health/slo_gap_detector_test.go (new), serving/circuit/manager.go (integration hooks and staged restore state), serving/circuit/manager_test.go (transition tests), config/schemas/staged_restore.yaml (schema change), config/migrations/20260210_add_staged_restore.py (migration), telemetry/flags.go (higher fidelity sampling toggle), docs/ops/staged-restoration.md (short doc snippet).

Commits (summary): "introduce slo gap detector and unit tests"; "wire gap detector into circuit manager and add staged restore state"; "add config schema and migration for staged restore"; "telemetry sampling toggle and e2e harness update"; "feature-flag and runtime metrics".

Review conversation (high-level): Priya: "Looks good; please double-check the threshold defaults and make them conservative." Marcus: "Adjusted defaults to be 2x current sensitivity and documented rationale in staged-restoration.md." Ava: "Can we make the telemetry toggle non-persistent?" Marcus: "Yes, implemented as a transient flag scoped to the staged restore window." Diego: "Verified tests and did a quick staging run; approving pending minor doc tweak." Final: Approved-by Priya Kapoor, Ava Patel, Diego Rivera.
release_notes: Introduced SLO gap detector and staged quiet restoration to reduce circuit reopen oscillations during regional recoveries. Feature-flagged and opt-in per region. Improves reopen stability and reduces cascading SLO breaches.
notes_for_oncall: If noisy metrics prevent reopen, check slo_gap_detector gap_score metrics (runtime.health.slo_gap_score) and adjust staged_restore.threshold under config; rollback via feature flag if needed.
